The '''Marcol Void''' was an expanse of empty space in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]]. Measuring roughly thirty [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]] across, the Void had no planetary systems and very little debris. The Marcol Void separated the Imperial controlled region of the sector, centered around [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]], from the independent [[Kathol Outback/Legends|Kathol Outback]]. Ships with a Class One [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] took fourteen days to cross the Void, and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] would often blind-jump into the region since there was virtually no chance of hitting anything.

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] crossed the Marcol Void on his way to [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]] with his fleet. He was followed by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]''.
